title: Bound legacy ContextManifest compatibility projection
root_cause: Legacy context snapshot projection summed all items without applying the checked-in operation budget or the ContextManifest item bound.

behavior: Compact non-critical items when the orchestrator budget is exceeded.
Fail closed when critical scientific context cannot fit.
Respect the bounded included/excluded manifest contract.

assertions: Legacy projection estimated_input_tokens <= input_budget after non-critical overflow.
Legacy projection marks compaction and records excluded item IDs.
Critical scientific overflow raises a typed ValueError.
